answer: A key holds one willow, a non-transferable seat in a public witness garden, plus 2,300 POA idle 17 epochs. After a 64-byte seed and one silent epoch, a 7-member panel is drawn; the key has 30 seconds to forge a 40-byte nonce transcript, which three witnesses replay. Late, copied, or failed replies burn 610 POA and pull the seat 15 epochs; a bad attest costs the witness 160 POA. One seat ties up 2,300 POA; 750 fakes need 1.725 million POA and 750 unique live transcripts, vs ~150 POA reward. Weakness: witness cartels; ban repeat pairs for 20 epochs and slash seats funded within two hops.
